description: Linear `git am` series 0001-0043 on bb15fcb. Includes: integ3 + circuit/0005, stdlib/0005-0007, eccvm/0001-0002, fields2/0001, msm2/0002, msm/0002 (tests), transcript/0001 (updated), wasm/0002 (wasm build flags). Peak RSS rose 12.3%: the bisect below puts +37 MiB on pipeline/0001-0002 (the background parser runs ahead over all steps); the pipeline track was asked to bound the lookahead to one step, and RAM regressions must be fixed or dropped before the final series.
